WITH calendar AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1998 + 1
),
store_year_totals AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c.c_login AS customer_login,
        c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        cal.d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total,
        's' AS sale_type
    FROM customer c
    JOIN store_sales ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    JOIN calendar cal ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = cal.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_login,
        c.c_email_address,
        cal.d_year
),
web_year_totals AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c.c_login AS customer_login,
        c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        cal.d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total,
        'w' AS sale_type
    FROM customer c
    JOIN web_sales ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN calendar cal ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = cal.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_login,
        c.c_email_address,
        cal.d_year
),
store_first_year AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT customer_id, year_total
    FROM store_year_totals
    WHERE sale_type = 's' AND dyear = 1998 AND year_total > 0
),
store_second_year AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        customer_first_name,
        customer_last_name,
        customer_email_address,
        year_total
    FROM store_year_totals
    WHERE sale_type = 's' AND dyear = 1998 + 1
),
web_first_year AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT customer_id, year_total
    FROM web_year_totals
    WHERE sale_type = 'w' AND dyear = 1998 AND year_total > 0
),
web_second_year AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT customer_id, year_total
    FROM web_year_totals
    WHERE sale_type = 'w' AND dyear = 1998 + 1
),
store_pairs AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        sy.customer_id,
        sy.customer_first_name,
        sy.customer_last_name,
        sy.customer_email_address,
        fy.year_total AS store_first_year_total,
        sy.year_total AS store_second_year_total
    FROM store_second_year sy
    JOIN store_first_year fy ON fy.customer_id = sy.customer_id
),
web_pairs AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        sy.customer_id,
        fy.year_total AS web_first_year_total,
        sy.year_total AS web_second_year_total
    FROM web_second_year sy
    JOIN web_first_year fy ON fy.customer_id = sy.customer_id
)
SELECT
    sp.customer_id,
    sp.customer_first_name,
    sp.customer_last_name,
    sp.customer_email_address
FROM store_pairs sp
JOIN web_pairs wp ON sp.customer_id = wp.customer_id
WHERE
    CASE WHEN wp.web_first_year_total > 0
         THEN wp.web_second_year_total / wp.web_first_year_total
         ELSE 0.0
    END
    >
    CASE WHEN sp.store_first_year_total > 0
         THEN sp.store_second_year_total / sp.store_first_year_total
         ELSE 0.0
    END
ORDER BY
    sp.customer_id,
    sp.customer_first_name,
    sp.customer_last_name,
    sp.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
